name: review-cost
description: Before a git push triggers the automatic second-model review, shows its estimated token cost (green / amber / red) and lets you choose Review or Skip.

greenMaxTokens.title: Green up to (tokens)
greenMaxTokens.description: Estimated reviews up to this many tokens are Green (small).

redMinTokens.title: Red from (tokens)
redMinTokens.description: Estimated reviews of at least this many tokens are Red (many); anything between is Amber.

askWhen.title: Ask when
askWhen.description: amber-red: green reviews only show a one-line note and go ahead; always: ask every time.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Input USD per million tokens
inputUsdPerMTok.description: Optional. With the output price below, adds an API-equivalent dollar figure. 0 = show no dollars.

outputUsdPerMTok.title: Output USD per million tokens
outputUsdPerMTok.description: Optional. See above. 0 = show no dollars.

coloredBanner.title: Colored banner
coloredBanner.description: Draw the level line in green/amber/red above the question. Turn off if the dialog ever looks wrong; the level word is always in the text.
